entries.body: Stage1 done in exporter/core.py export_records(records,user,params): CSV header id,title,owner,amount via csv.writer lineterminator \n, asc id; viewer->PermissionError; admin all projects, else project in user[projects]; only active unless params include_archived is True. Records: id,title,owner,project,status,amount(str),confidential,created.

Stage2 done: confidential True excluded unless admin and purpose==audit; since YYYY-MM-DD filter created>=since (str compare [:10]). OBLIGATION: if format changes from CSV, add top-level exported_by=user[name] unless withdrawn.
Stage3 done: output now json.dumps({exported_by:user[name], records:[{id int,title,owner,amount str}]}) asc id (replaces CSV). core.py ends with that return.
